title: Die in GTA 6 and Every Dollar in Your Pocket Is Gone 💸 #Shorts
description:
In GTA 6, dying or getting busted costs you all the cash in your pocket, plus a small BuckMe bank fee. Jason and Lucia can each carry up to $20,000. Bank it with the BuckMe app (it unlocks through the story mission "Buck Me" early on) or, before that, hide cash under the loose floorboards in Jason's bedroom. Warning: when Chapter 1 ends, pocket cash and checking are wiped; only Family Savings (up to $5,000) carries over. No story spoilers.

Pocket or bank? Comment below!

Sources: GTABase, "How to Keep Your Money Safe in GTA 6" (Nov 19, 2026); Red Bull Games, "GTA 6 beginner's guide" (Nov 19, 2026). Images: official Rockstar Games trailers.
